How it works

One introduction. We handle the rest.

Here’s exactly what happens after you refer a business owner: what you do, what your client experiences and what our funding team takes care of.

Book your demo call →See how you get paid

The referral journey

From introduction to funded deal. Three points of view.

YouYour clientLendTrack team
  1. 01Day 0

    You make the introduction

    You

    Share your funding page link, hand over a flyer or submit a client you already have in mind.

    Your client

    Answers a few quick questions in minutes. Checking their options has no impact on their credit.

    LendTrack team

    The lead lands in our pipeline, tagged to you, and shows up in your dashboard.

  2. 02Within 24 hours

    A funding specialist calls your client

    You

    Nothing to do. You can see the status change in your dashboard.

    Your client

    Talks through what they need the money for, how much and how fast.

    LendTrack team

    A dedicated specialist learns the business and qualifies the deal.

  3. 03Days 1 to 3

    Documents and underwriting

    You

    Watch for updates. If documents are missing, we handle the follow-up.

    Your client

    Uploads bank statements through a secure link. No paperwork piles.

    LendTrack team

    Our AI and underwriters analyze the file and match it with the right lenders.

  4. 04Offers

    Your client compares real offers

    You

    See when your referral is approved.

    Your client

    Reviews options with clear costs and terms, then chooses the best fit. No obligation.

    LendTrack team

    Negotiates with lenders and explains every offer in plain language.

  5. 05Funded

    The deal funds. You get paid.

    You

    Your 30% share is paid by direct deposit under the terms of your partner agreement.

    Your client

    Gets the capital, often in as little as 1 to 3 business days depending on the program.

    LendTrack team

    Closes the deal, collects the commission and pays your share.

FAQ

Questions about the process

What if my client doesn’t qualify?

Our specialist will tell them clearly and, where possible, suggest what would improve their chances. There’s no cost to your client for exploring options.

How fast do clients get funded?

It depends on the product. Working capital can fund in 1 to 3 business days. SBA loans take longer because they require more documentation.

Can I submit a client directly instead of sending a link?

Yes. From your dashboard you can submit a client you have in mind, and our team reaches out to them.

Will I know what’s happening with my referral?

Yes. Every referral shows its live status in your dashboard, and the funding team sends updates when something changes.
